comment: Independent detect.c:do_vicinity_map spell entry via spell.c:spelleffects(SPE_CLAIRVOYANCE), frozen from the C menu's SPE_DIG+i order: SPE_CLAIRVOYANCE=385 is offset 19, selected with t on the first a-u page. Wizard starts with P_DIVINATION_SPELL at Expert in u_init.c:Skill_W, so spell.c sets pseudo->blessed and C takes extended detection. The trailing Escape exits getpos if the extended map reports newly detected creatures or objects; if no browse prompt is raised it is a harmless command boundary. Seed/date are new to exercise this entry.
